questions.question: In your role overseeing accounting for 21 Beauty First retail salons, how did you reconcile cost of goods at month-end and investigate material inventory variances?
Describe your experience maintaining inventory controls using a just-in-time approach at the Department of the Interior. How did you ensure the records remained accurate?

This role requires ownership of inventory reconciliations across warehouses. Walk us through an inventory or balance-sheet reconciliation you performed, including the data sources, reconciliation process, and how you resolved discrepancies.
What experience do you have creating, maintaining, or validating bills of materials, standard costs, or additional product costs such as labor, handling, or freight?
You have used SAP, AS400, JDE, and CAMS. How have you used ERP data alongside spreadsheets to validate accounting records or support month-end close?

At Southern Company, you tracked capital-job spending for budget compliance and set up assets in JDE and CAMS. How did you ensure documentation, costs, and system records were complete and accurate before an asset was finalized?
Describe a time you identified an accounting, coding, purchasing, or inventory-control issue. What was the root cause, whom did you involve, and what corrective action did you implement?
How would you evaluate whether month-end freight costs should be capitalized into inventory, expensed, or billed to an end customer? What documentation and accounting considerations would you review?
Tell us about your experience supporting audits, including the yearly audits at Beauty First or sales-tax audits at Macquarie Group. How did you prepare support and respond to auditor questions?

This position requires working with operations, warehouse/location personnel, finance, and leadership when inventory records do not agree. Describe a situation where you had to resolve a disagreement or concern with non-accounting stakeholders while maintaining accounting integrity.
